name: label
title: Label
description: A label component with asterisk indicator and sub-text. Uses namespace exports: Label.Root, Label.Asterisk, Label.Sub.

migration.guide: API changed: import as namespace `import * as Label from ...`, use `<Label.Root>`, `<Label.Asterisk>`, `<Label.Sub>`. Old named export `{ Label }` removed. New sub-components: `Label.Asterisk` (primary color), `Label.Sub` for optional text. Supports `disabled` prop on Root.

docs.lead: A label component with required asterisk indicator and optional sub-text for form inputs.
docs.usage:
import * as Label from "@/components/ui/label"

<Label.Root>
  Field Name
  <Label.Asterisk />
  <Label.Sub>(Optional)</Label.Sub>
</Label.Root>

examples.title: Demo
examples.description: Label with asterisk, sub-text, and info icon.

api.name: Label.Root
api.description: The root label element built on Radix Label.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable the label and apply disabled styling to all children

api.name: Label.Asterisk
api.description: Required field asterisk indicator in primary color.

api.name: Label.Sub
api.description: Secondary text displayed after the label.
